title: ericoides subulatum
intro: Ericoides subulatum, commonly known as Snowy Mountain Hebe or Snow Mountain Hebe, is a species of flowering plant in the family Plantaginaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ericoides subulatum include expectorant and antipyretic effects, which can help relieve congestion and reduce fever. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, although further research is needed to confirm the exact composition and effects of Ericoides subulatum.
